title: Understanding Fold Size
text: To determine the size of each fold, consider how you would divide the total number of samples by the number of folds, k. This will give you the number of samples in each fold.

title: Shuffling the Indices
text: The function np.random.permutation is used to shuffle the indices of the dataset. This ensures that each fold is a random subset of the data.

title: Creating Validation Indices
text: For the validation indices, think about how you can select a specific segment of the shuffled indices for each fold. This segment should correspond to the current fold number.
